name: metricraven
description: Ask about your MetricRaven web analytics: visitors, traffic sources, revenue attribution, goals and funnels, with interactive charts.

interface.longDescription: Ask about your MetricRaven web analytics in plain language. See visitors and revenue over time as an interactive chart, find which channels, campaigns, pages and countries bring visitors and paying customers, check goals and funnels, and see who is on your site right now. MetricRaven only reads the websites and permissions you approve when you connect, and checks your current access on every request. Read access is enough for every report; changes such as adding chart notes or alerts, or creating and updating funnels, segments and page or link goals, need the write permission and ask before they run. Connected apps cannot delete anything.
defaultPrompt: Chart my visitors and revenue for the last 30 days.
Which channels brought the most revenue this month?
Show my top pages by visitors this week.

positive.prompt: Show me a chart of visitors and revenue for Orbit Analytics over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the interactive chart with daily visitors and revenue, totals and the change against the previous 30 days, and summarizes them in a sentence.

positive.prompt: Which channels brought in the most revenue this month on Orbit Analytics?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks channels by revenue for month to date with visitors and revenue for each, using only Orbit Analytics data.

positive.prompt: What were the top 5 pages on Orbit Analytics in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the five pages with the most visitors in the last 7 days with visitor and pageview counts.

positive.prompt: Show the signup funnel for Orbit Analytics and where visitors drop off.
positive.expected_behavior: Describes each funnel step with conversions and the largest drop-off, using the funnels saved on the demo site.

positive.prompt: How many people are on Orbit Analytics right now, and from which countries?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports current visitors and their approximate countries from the last few minutes without naming individuals.

negative.prompt: Show me the traffic for google.com.
Book me a flight to Madrid next Friday.

review.commerce_description: MetricRaven does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT; it reports revenue that customers record in their own analytics.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: new read tools for JavaScript errors, page speed (Web Vitals next to conversion), visitor paths, custom event properties and goal definitions. With the write permission, the app can now create and update funnels, segments and page or link goals; update tools are marked destructive because they replace the saved definition. Connected apps still cannot delete anything.
